content: Yazdī collection item 1, continued: MK's footnote identifies Muḥammad Ṣūfī b. Tarkhān as a tovachi and commander of a tümen in Shāhrukh's army, one of the Tarkhān amirs (sons of Temür's follower Ghiyās al-Dīn Tarkhān, who was also the father of Shāhrukh's influential wife Gawharshād) prominent in Shāhrukh's army and administration.
